name: Weather
description: The temperature now, and a forecast when you click it. Off until Settings -> Weather is turned on: it is the one widget that talks to the internet, and it asks Open-Meteo for a place and nothing else.

showTemperature.label: Show the temperature
showTemperature.description: Beside the icon. Off leaves the icon alone, which is narrower on a full panel.

showPlace.label: Show the place
showPlace.description: The town the forecast is for, after the temperature.

days.label: Days shown
days.description: How many days of the forecast the popout lists.
